deals.travelWindow: Nov 14 – mid Dec, Allegiant nonstop; Dec 13 from $56 one-way, Nov 14 $62, Dec 6 $68
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant nonstop one-way from $56 (Dec 13) and $62 (Nov 14), about $118–145 round trip; edges Fort Lauderdale by a couple dollars and Great Smoky Mountains NP is an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Compact Market Square and Old City are walkable, locals are friendly, and the Urban Wilderness trails are inside the city.

highlights: Market Square and Old City evenings
Sunsphere observation deck (free)
Urban Wilderness trails and Ijams Nature Center
Smokies day trip: Alum Cave or Laurel Falls
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square, Sunsphere, Old City
Day 2 — Rental car to Great Smoky Mountains NP, Laurel Falls or Alum Cave Trail
Day 3 — Sunrise at Ijams Nature Center or the Urban Wilderness loop, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable, but you need a rental car for the Smokies.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square, for walkability and food.

deals.travelWindow: Nov – Feb, Allegiant nonstop; $60 one-way on Nov 14, Jan 10, Jan 21, Jan 30, Feb 6
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $60 on many dates (Nov 14, Jan 10/21/30, Feb 6), about $120–145 round trip; $9 lower than yesterday's low end, with Everglades 1 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable Las Olas and Riverwalk, a free water taxi network, and cheap hostels near the beach make it easy alone.

highlights: Riverwalk and Las Olas Boulevard on foot
Fort Lauderdale Beach and the A1A promenade
Water Taxi day pass along the Intracoastal
Everglades airboat or Shark Valley tram day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Arrive FLL, beach and A1A walk, sunset at Las Olas Beach
Day 2 — Everglades day trip: Anhinga Trail at Royal Palm, then Shark Valley tram
Day 3 — Riverwalk, Water Taxi to Hugh Taylor Birch State Park, evening on Las Olas
guide.gettingAround: Airport is 3 miles from downtown; use Brightline/Tri-Rail, the Water Taxi and rideshare. Rent a car only for the Everglades day.
guide.stayArea: Beach area near Las Olas or downtown by Riverwalk: walkable with hostels and budget hotels.

deals.travelWindow: Nov – Jan, Allegiant nonstop; Jan 3 from $68 one-way, Dec 31 $74, Nov 19 $88
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $68 (Jan 3) and $74 (Dec 31), about $142–165 round trip, down from yesterday; easy solo city but the nearest park-type area is 2.5 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable downtown, a large craft-beer and museum scene, and a safe, easy-to-navigate small city.

highlights: Frederik Meijer Gardens and Sculpture Park
Downtown brewery trail (Founders, Brewery Vivant)
Grand Rapids Art Museum
Lake Michigan dunes at Hoffmaster or Grand Haven
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown, GR Art Museum, brewery evening
Day 2 — Meijer Gardens, then Lake Michigan at Grand Haven pier
Day 3 — Rental car to Hoffmaster dunes boardwalk, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable and the DASH shuttle is free; rent a car for the lakeshore.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or Heritage Hill for walkability to breweries and museums.

deals.travelWindow: Dec – Jan, Allegiant nonstop; Dec 11, Dec 31 and Jan 2 from $87 one-way
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way $87 (Dec 11, Dec 31, Jan 2), about $174–195 round trip; the Blue Ridge Parkway and Smokies edge it ahead of cheaper Sarasota.
deals.soloWhy: Compact, walkable downtown with a strong hostel and brewery scene, plus easy trailheads close to town.

highlights: Downtown Asheville and the River Arts District on foot
Blue Ridge Parkway overlooks, including Craggy Gardens
Biltmore Estate grounds
Brewery row on Wedge and Coxe Ave
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown walk, River Arts District studios, dinner on Biltmore Ave
Day 2 — Rental car up the Blue Ridge Parkway: Craggy Gardens Pinnacle, Graveyard Fields if open
Day 3 — Biltmore grounds or Mount Pisgah views, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable but the Parkway and trailheads need a rental car; check Parkway closures for winter ice.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the Montford/South Slope area for walkable food and breweries.

deals.travelWindow: Dec – Apr, Allegiant nonstop; Feb 22 from $70 one-way, Dec 11 $88, Jan 25 $88
deals.whyRanked: Allegiant one-way from $70 (Feb 22) and $88 (Dec 11, Jan 25), about $158–180 round trip; beaches and Myakka River State Park, but no national park nearby.
deals.soloWhy: Siesta Key and downtown are pleasant and safe, but you will want a car for most of it.

highlights: Siesta Key Beach's white sand
Myakka River State Park canopy walkway
Ringling Museum grounds
Downtown Sarasota bayfront and Saturday farmers market
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown bayfront, Selby Gardens, dinner on Main St
Day 2 — Siesta Key Beach morning, Ringling Museum afternoon
Day 3 — Myakka River State Park canopy walk and airboat, then fly home
guide.gettingAround: A rental car is the realistic option; the Siesta Key trolley helps for beach days.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Sarasota for walkable dining, or Siesta Village for beach access.
